oddish-solar-beam.name: Solar Beam
oddish-solar-beam.description: Bond skill: a beam of gathered sunlight at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 110).

oddish-grassy-terrain.name: Grassy Terrain
oddish-grassy-terrain.description: Bond skill: lush grass up to 2 hexes away heals allies in a 1-hex area 30 HP.

oddish-moonlight.name: Moonlight
oddish-moonlight.description: Bond skill: soft moonlight heals it and adjacent allies by 25 HP.

oddish-night-bloom.name: Night Bloom
oddish-night-bloom.description: Draws strength from moonlight: heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

oddish-toxic-nectar.name: Toxic Nectar
oddish-toxic-nectar.description: Deals 20% more damage to Poisoned foes.

oddish-sleep-powder.name: Sleep Powder
oddish-sleep-powder.description: New skill: a powder that puts a foe up to 2 hexes away to Sleep for 2 turns.

oddish-mega-drain.name: Mega Drain
oddish-mega-drain.description: New skill: drains a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 55), healing by part of the damage.

oddish-moonblast.name: Moonblast
oddish-moonblast.description: New skill: draws on the moon's power to blast a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 75).

oddish-sweet-scent.name: Sweet Scent
oddish-sweet-scent.description: New skill: a sweet scent leaves every foe within 2 hexes Marked for 2 turns.

oddish-lingering-spores.name: Lingering Spores
oddish-lingering-spores.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

oddish-deep-roots.name: Deep Roots
oddish-deep-roots.description: Its Grass moves drain 10% more of the damage dealt as HP.

oddish-sludge-bomb.name: Sludge Bomb
oddish-sludge-bomb.description: New skill: hurls toxic sludge at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 85), Poisoning it for 2 turns.

oddish-energy-ball.name: Energy Ball
oddish-energy-ball.description: New skill: an orb of nature's energy bursts on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 85).

oddish-night-sap.name: Night Sap
oddish-night-sap.description: Heals 10% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

oddish-leaf-storm.name: Leaf Storm
oddish-leaf-storm.description: New skill: a storm of sharp leaves at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 100).

oddish-aromatherapy.name: Aromatherapy
oddish-aromatherapy.description: New skill: a soothing aroma clears foes' statuses and heals 40 HP on it and adjacent allies.

oddish-spreading-spores.name: Spreading Spores
oddish-spreading-spores.description: When a foe carrying a status it applied faints, adjacent foes catch that status.

oddish-fragrant-bloom.name: Fragrant Bloom
oddish-fragrant-bloom.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes carrying a status an ally applied.

oddish-rafflesia.name: Rafflesia
oddish-rafflesia.description: Capstone. Deals 20% more damage to foes carrying any status; cannot be Poisoned or put to Sleep.

oddish-chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
oddish-chlorophyll.description: Soaks up sunlight: its Grass moves deal 15% more damage.

oddish-easy-prey.name: Easy Prey
oddish-easy-prey.description: Deals 25% more damage to Sleeping or Paralysed foes.

oddish-moonlit-bloom.name: Moonlit Bloom
oddish-moonlit-bloom.description: Capstone. Its Bond skills cost 1 less; each combo it lands gives the team 1 Bond.
